title: Nonce-keyed state/event procedure execution
priority: Supersedes obsolete indexed-iterator and renderer handoff mechanics only; all unrelated AGENTS.json instructions and full state/schema requirements continue to apply.

persistent_record.inputs: All accepted prior input values keyed by semantic keyword

reference.preservation: Existing complete instructions, compact projections, full return schemas, schema_derivation rules, read_keywords, diagnostics, and semantic validators must not be shortened or discarded.

events.nonce: Fetch saved record and render its stored state.projection without recalculation.
events.nonce(input): Fetch record; validate input using stored state.projection.final_schema and state-specific substantive validator. On rejection save diagnostic on current projection and re-render. On acceptance save value in inputs[state.keyword]; generate next state using state.next, resolving read_keywords against inputs and deriving final_schema; save the new record under the same nonce before rendering. At null next mark complete.

generation.schema_derivation: The state's derive_schema binding identifies the function called at projection construction, never on replay or after render.
generation.render: Output-only; must not collect the next input or produce a separate issuedSchema.
